race.title: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Brown Lad Handicap Hurdle (Listed)
race.verdict: A typically wide-open renewal. The vote goes to BALLYBAWN BELTER , who reverts to hurdling on a handy mark following her recent Flat success. Brosna Queen , Le Moulin Rouge , Carrigg Island and Avondale head an extensive list of dangers. BALLYBAWN BELTER (IRE) BROSNA QUEEN (IRE) LE MOULIN ROUGE (FR)
